prompt: Employees ask an assistant about the company's own leave policy, which the model was never trained on.
why: Retrieve the policy documents and add them to the prompt: grounding with your data (RAG).
trap: Examples teach format, not facts the model lacks.

prompt: Answers must quote and link the exact manual page they came from.
tells: quote and link the exact manual page
why: Retrieved passages make answers grounded and citable.
trap: Transparency is the principle; RAG is the technique.

prompt: A shopping assistant gives last year's prices. Today's catalog is in a database the app can search.
why: Ground answers in current data by retrieving it at question time.
trap: An agent could call a tool, but retrieving facts to ground answers is RAG.

prompt: A support bot invents plausible return rules. The team wants answers to come only from the official policy documents.
tells: only from the official policy documents
why: Grounding in retrieved documents reduces made-up answers.
trap: Lower temperature makes it consistent, not correct.

prompt: For each question, the app searches an index of the product manuals and puts the top three passages in the prompt.
tells: puts the top three passages in the prompt
why: Retrieve, then generate: grounding with your data.
trap: The passages are facts to answer from, not examples.

prompt: Policies change every week, and the team wants the assistant's answers to stay current without retraining.
why: RAG uses current documents at question time, so updates need no training.
trap: Fine-tuning would need retraining for every change.

prompt: A team plans to fine-tune a model so it knows this week's prices. Which approach would suit that better?
why: Fast-changing facts are better retrieved at question time with RAG.
trap: Fine-tuning teaches behavior, and would need retraining every week.

prompt: An internal helpdesk bot answers only from the company wiki, quoting the page it used.
tells: answers only from the company wiki
why: Answers grounded in retrieved company content are RAG.
trap: Fine-tuning wouldn't let it quote pages.
